⏰ Your laptop doesn't actually know what time it is.

Neither does your phone. Or your smartwatch. Or even the atomic clock sitting in a military bunker.

Every device you own is constantly asking someone else for the correct time—and the entire internet depends on everyone agreeing on the same answer.

In this episode, Caya investigates why missing out on concert tickets led him down the rabbit hole of internet time. We explore why your computer's clock drifts, how Network Time Protocol (NTP) keeps billions of devices synchronized,
title: This Extra Second Keeps Crashing the Internet
